buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 100% of total value. 9. Purchase Preference (Centre) Preference to Make In India products (For bids less than 200 Crore):Preference shall be given to Class 1 local supplier as defined in public procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 as amended from time to time and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Nodal Ministry for specific Goods/Products. The minimum local content to qualify as a Class 1 local supplier is denoted in the bid document 50%. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must upload a certificate from the OEM regarding the percentage of the local content and the details of locations at which the local value addition is made along with their bid, failing which no purchase preference shall be granted. In case the bid value is more than Rs 10 Crore, the declaration relating to percentage of local content shall be certified by the statutory auditor or cost auditor, if the OEM is a company and by a practicing cost accountant or a chartered accountant for OEMs other than companies as per the Public Procurement (preference to Make-in -India) order 2017 dated 04.06.2020. Only Class-I and Class-II Local suppliers as per MII order dated 4.6.2020 will be eligible to bid. Non - Local suppliers as per MII order dated 04.06.2020 are not eligible to participate. In case Buyer has selected Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises clause in the bid, the same will get precedence over this clause. 10. Pursuant to GeM SLA, this agreement can also be revised / modified on mutual consent of the stakehold ers. 9. The place of deployment of the vehicles may be changed from time to time within the States of Maha rashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh during the contract period, depending on the requirements of the work. Normally, the drilling units to which these vehicles are attached are likely to be relocated at lea st 2–3 times during the year, depending on the progress of drilling operations and the targets assigned. F urther, the requirement for vehicles may decrease temporarily in the event of suspension of drilling oper ations by any unit for any reason. 11. The vehicle(s) and driver(s) shall be exclusively placed under the control of the Unit-in-charge and shal l not move elsewhere without permission. The vehicle will be stationed 24x7 at the field camp. 12. Taxes and permits: The vehicle should have varied documents of following, which should provider duri ng the currency of contract: i. Registration Certificate ii. Motor vehicle tax iii. Fast tag (to be reimbursed as actual) iv. Comprehensive insurance policy v. Fitness certificate

vi. Pollution Under Control certificate (PUC) vii. Taxi permit License 13. Provision of Driver: i. The contractor will provide the vehicles along with required number of drivers possessing a valid li cense driving. The driver should be experience, skilled, literate, courteous and a man of character. ii. The driver should not be under influence of alcohol or any type of intoxication or drugs whatsoeve r. While driving he should keep his mobile phone in silent/vibration mode. iii. The driver shall report to duty as per the requirements of the consignee. iv. The contractor has to follow the labour laws / relevant laws in regard to weekly off, wages, etc. to the Driver. If behavior of the driver(s) is (are) not satisfactory, officer-in-charge shall have the right t o ask the contractor to replace the concerned driver within 48 hours. v. Accommodation and social need for the driver is to be arranged by the contractor. 14. Maintenance/Repair of vehicle: i. The Service Provide shall at his own cost, arrange for all materials, manpower, spare, tools, tackle s, etc. and regular checking / maintenance / repair of the vehicle and keep it in good condition at all time. ii. During the period of vehicle maintenance and/or repairs, diesel and/or engine oil will not be provi ded by the GSI, CR in any case. iii. For the routine repair and maintenance of the vehicle, one day off in a month for each vehicle ma y be provided as per the convenience of GSI, CR. 15. In case of breakdown: The Service Provider shall provide replacement vehicle(s) immediately (withi n 04 hours) after receiving breakdown information of the engaged vehicle of any nature at any place of wo rking. No payment of hiring charges shall be made if vehicle is not provided for that particular period and i n the event of such happenings, it shall be binding for the Service Provider to provide substitute vehicle of equivalent capacity for the break down period, in good conditions and with requisite documents. If the vehi cle is not made available within 04 hours of giving information, penalty shall be implemented as per SLA of GeM. 16. Compensation, in case of accident: The GSI, CR shall not be responsible for payment of any claim or compensation of any kind to the Service Provider, its driver or any other third person/party agency agai nst claim or compensation of any nature whatsoever, arising out of any accident or any other unlawful act of the driver and due to fitness of the vehicle(s) The Service Provider shall be exclusively responsible for s uch payments of compensation if any. 17. Compliance with statutory provisions: The Service Provider shall familiarize himself and fully com ply with the provision of all the Acts/Rules/Regulation/By-Laws and orders of the Local authorities/Municipal ity/State Govt./Central Govt./DTO/RTO applicable to the worker, Mines Act, Payment of Wages Act, Motor v ehicle Act, Workmen's Compensation Act etc and shall be fully responsible and liable for due observance of the same. The GSI, CR shall have no responsibility and liability whatsoever on these accounts and the service provider shall fully indemnify the GSI, CR against any claim/dispute, etc. arising out of the same, w henever the GSI, CR asks for documents related to labor laws to Service Provider. 18. Liabilities of the service provider: Payment of Government Tax/ duty or other charges for plying t he vehicles shall be the liability of the service provider. The vehicle should have comprehensive insurance cover for all stakeholders. The Service Provider has to ensure that the vehicles supplied are in good conditi on, clean and fully upholstered. If the Service Provider fails to provide the vehicle to GSI for any reason wh atsoever, and if the service is not found satisfactory enough, GSI shall have the right to impose penalty as per terms and conditions mentioned in GeM SLA, and make deductions in payment of monthly bill / termin ate the contract in whole or part as deemed necessary. The service provider shall assign the job of driving hired vehicles to qualified experienced licensed drivers only, and also assume full responsibility for the saf ety and security of the officers/officials as well as essential store items while running the vehicle by ensurin g safe driving. The driver of the vehicle shall be well behaved, physically and mentally fit, in possession of a valid commercial driving license issued by RTO for the class of vehicle he is driving. He should not smoke , chew Pan/Pan masala/Tobacco inside the car both while driving or otherwise. The employees of the servic e provider shall not be deemed to be employees of the user department, hence the compliance of the appl icable laws will be the sole responsibility of the service provider. The engagement of drivers in the hired ve hicles shall not lead to any commitment and future liability like regularization and absorption in GSI. The s ervice provider shall be personally responsible for any theft, misconduct and /or disobedience on the part of drivers provided by him. All expenses necessary to keep the vehicle in running and good condition, incl

uding expenses on vehicle repair and maintenance etc. shall be borne by the service provider. However, t olls, parking fees or entry taxes shall be borne by Indenting Division of GSI on the basis of actual valid par king receipt duly countersigned by the user. Further, pursuant to GeM SLA, in case of any violation of traffic rules and / or infringement of any other law s, legal disputes/cases/claims that have arisen or may arise during the currency of the agreement in respe ct of vehicles provided by the Service Provider, or any accident resulting in loss or damage to property of li fe, the sole responsibility for any legal or financial implication would solely rest with the Service Provider. T he Service Provider shall also be liable for all fines, penalties and traffic and other criminal offences arising out of or concerning the use of the vehicle during the entire period of hire. Accommodation and social need for the driver is to be arranged by the contractor. The vehicle(s) and driver(s) shall exclusively be placed u nder the control of the consignee and shall not move elsewhere without permission. The vehicle will be sta tioned 24x7 at the field camp. Vehicle will not always run on motorable roads but in remote areas, forest, hilly terrain, kaccha roads etc. as per nature of work. 19. Accuracy of meters: The meter reading should tally with the actual distance run. Authorized officer shall have full power to check the meter for its correctness at any point of time, and take action accordingl y. 20. Logbook: Pursuant to GeM SLA, daily Logbook (as per proforma provided hereunder) is to be maintai ned by the Service Provider as per prescribed proforma. Logbook is to be signed by the officer using the v ehicle including filling of full name, designation and details/ purpose of journey. The Service Provider shall ensure that the log book is properly filled and signed by the user along with names and designations befor e closing the duty. The completed and signed monthly logbook shall be submitted along with the monthly bill for processing. Time and kilometer reading of service shall start from the point of pickup to the point of final drop off and the garage hours and kilometer shall not be included. Proper Log Book shall be maintain ed by the driver regarding odometer readings, in & out time, mileage, maintenance, etc. duly counter sign ed by the Unit-in-charge or user of the vehicle. The Log Book has to be maintained for each vehicle separa tely. cases. 22. Provisioning of Fuel: i. HSD will be provided by GSI as per actual consumption. Mileage of vehicle should not be less than 10km/l (Kilometer per liter). ii. GSI may provide engine oil at the rate of 1 liter per 500 km run on a monthly basis, upon receiving a requisition from the Service Provider. iii. The service provider shall make up for any shortfall of HSD in case vehicle average falls below sp ecified 10 km/l (kilometer per liter). iv. Payment: Payment will be made on a monthly basis after receipt of invoice complete and correct in a ll respects. a) Bill/Invoice for Total kilometers/ no of days run during a month is to be submitted before the 5th da y of the following month. b) In order to make payment by Electronic Clearance System through bank, following information shal l be provided along with the bill:- i. Company's GST No. ii. Name of the Beneficiary or party (i.e to whom payment is to be made) iii. PAN No. iv. Aadhar No. v. Bank Account No. vi. Type of Account (Current/Savings) vii. All deductions / fines etc. as per GeM SLA will be settled before making the payments. (a) For online payment, monthly bills along with logbook in triplicate shall be submitted to the AP&MD, CR through Consignee/Indenting Division for processing for payment. (b) During the contract period, Non-availability of funds will not be linked to the non-attendance of services by the service Provider/Agencies. Not providing the vehicles for linking with payment will be treated as def ault on the part of the firm and will be counted as absent from the duty and accordingly a penalty will be i mposed by the competent authority. 24. All the other terms and conditions will be governed as per the GeM Contract (Purchase Order), General Terms and Conditions (GTC), Special Terms and Conditions (STC), GeM Service Level Agreement (SLA) and Additional Terms and Conditions (ATC) if any, as mentioned in the GeM Bid. The GeM Bid, GeM Contract, w ork order, LoA annexed to this agreement is an integral part of this agreement. Compliance of all terms an d conditions mentioned in the above mentioned documents is binding on the Service Provider. 25. Confidentiality: The service provider shall take all precautions not to disclose, divulge and / or disse minate to any third party any confidential information, proprietary information on the GSI's business or sec urity arrangements (including but not limited to the Assignment instructions, Schedules and other subsequ ent Agreements) and/or business of the GSI. The obligation is not limited to any scope and the firm shall b e held responsible in case of breach of the confidentiality of GSI's information. 26. Arbitration: In the event of any question, dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with thi s contract (except as to matter the decision to which is specifically provided under this agreement), such d isputes or difference shall be settled in accordance with the Indian Arbitration & Conciliation Act 1996, the rules there under and any statutory modifications or re-enactments thereof shall apply to the arbitration pr

oceedings. If amicable resolution on mutual settlement is not possible then the unresolved dispute or differ ence shall be referred to the sole arbitration by a person appointed by the Additional Director General, Ge ological Survey of India, Central Region and shall be conducted at the legal jurisdiction of GSI, CR, Nagpur and not the place where the contractor has his registered office. The arbitrator so appointed shall be final, conclusive and binding on all parties to this order. There shall be no objection that the arbitrator is a Gover nment Servant, that he has to deal with the matters to which the contract relates, or that in the course of his duties as a Government servant he has expressed views on all or any of the matters in dispute or differ ence. In the event of the Arbitrator dying, neglecting or refusing to act or resigning or being unable to act f or any reason, or his award being set aside by the court for any reason, it shall be lawful for the Additional Director General, GSI, CR to appoint another arbitrator in place of the outgoing arbitrator. The award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on the parties to this contract. 27. Termination for Insolvency: Geological Survey of India may also give written notice for termination of contract and without compensation to the contractor, terminate the contract if the contractor becomes unwilling, bankrupt or otherwise insolvent without affecting its right of action or remedy as hirer. 28. Force Majeure: If any time during the continuance of this contract, the performance in whole or in pa rt by either party of any obligation under this contract is prevented or delayed by reason of any war, or ho stility, acts of the public enemy, Civil commotion, sabotage, fires, floods, explosions, epidemics, quarantin e restrictions. Strikes, lockouts or act of God (hereinafter referred to as events) provided notice of happeni ngs, of any such eventually is given by either party to the other within 21 days from the date of occurrenc e thereof, neither party shall be reason of such events be entitled to terminate this contract nor shall eithe r party have any claim for damages against the other in respect of such on performance or delay in perfor mance under the contract shall be resumed as soon as practicable after such an event may come to an en d or cease to exist and the decision of Geological Survey of India as to whether the service have been to re sume or not shall be final and conclusive, provided further that if the performance in whole or part of any o bligation under this contract is prevented or delayed by reason of any such event for a period exceeding 6 0 days either party may, at his option terminate the contract. 29. Set Off: Any sum of money due and payable to the service provider (including security deposit refund able to him) under this contract may be appropriated by Geological survey of India and set off the same a gainst any claim of Geological survey of India for payment of a sum of money arising out of this contract or under any other contract made by service provider with Geological survey of India. 30. If the contractor fails to provide the Service to GSI and if the service is not found satisfactory enough, GSI shall have the right to impose penalty as per terms and conditions and terminate the contract in whole or part, if necessary. 31. The contract will also be guided by the terms and conditions of the Work Order containing same terms and conditions as mentioned in the GeM Contract. The tender enquiry/work order annexed to this agreeme nt is an integral part of this agreement. Compliance of all terms and conditions of the tender documents/W ork Order is binding on the contractor. 32.
